conclusion: Upstream c6804fbb68 makes eight final print-statistics placeholders available in custom G-code through reserved tags resolved after complete export: used_filament, print_time, normal_print_time, silent_print_time, total_weight, total_cost, total_wipe_tower_cost and total_wipe_tower_filament. Values match PrintStatistics::config used by filename_format; numeric values use two decimal places. Both reserved-tag tables include the new tags. Running extruded_* totals remain numeric and unchanged. The imported regression covers file header, machine start and machine end for Bambu and non-Bambu layouts. The original three-project command/path/configuration equality remains a historical result. Current final-statistics regressions still pass after generic emitted-layer planning; total_layer_count now uses the actual filtered output plan. No GUI, cross-platform or Provider release-readiness claim is made.
